cron:
  # ========== Phase 1: P0级Cron（今日部署）==========
  
  # 1. Token实时预警
  token-realtime-alert:
    schedule: "*/15 * * * *"
    command: "python3 scripts/token_monitor.py --threshold 20 --notify"
    tier: 1
    priority: P0
    enabled: true
    
  # 2. 每日晨报生成
  daily-morning-report:
    schedule: "55 8 * * *"
    command: "python3 skills/daily-report/generate.py --type morning"
    tier: 1
    priority: P0
    enabled: true
    
  # 3. 任务逾期提醒
  task-overdue-alert:
    schedule: "30 9 * * *"
